definitions.explanation: Actively and persistently seeking or striving for an ideal, goal, or quality. Implies a sustained effort toward something abstract or valued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧だ。
examples.english: The pursuit of happiness is a fundamental human right.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた。
examples.english: This craftsman has continued to pursue quality for many years.

notes:
{追求|ついきゅう} is a noun that can function as a suru verb ({追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). It focuses on the pursuit of abstract goals, ideals, or values.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [goal]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pursue a goal)
- [goal]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追求|ついきゅう} (the pursuit of a goal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pursue profit)
- ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pursue happiness)
- ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pursue an ideal)
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追求|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pursue quality)

Distinct from ⟦{追及|ついきゅう}→追及：09148_tsuikyuu⟧ (holding someone accountable, pressing for answers) and {追究|ついきゅう} (investigating, researching deeply). All three share the same reading but are written with different final kanji and have different meanings.
